title: OreStats
description: This plugin allows you to compare the ratio of minerals.
body:
_With this plugin, you no longer need to worry about cheaters on the servers. You have access to a useful command:_

**_- /orestats {Top | Player} {ore}_**

Simply type this command to find out the ore ratio obtained.

If you have any problems our discord: https://discord.gg/4DJV7h79fb
